title: Student Loan Calculator
description: Find your student loan payoff date from a monthly payment, or the payment needed for any term.
howto: Choose a mode: payoff time from your payment, or payment from a term.
Enter the balance and interest rate.
Read the payoff date, total interest or required payment.

faqs.a: From n = −ln(1 − r·P / payment) / ln(1 + r), the standard amortization inversion, where r is the monthly rate.

faqs.q: What if my payment barely covers interest?
faqs.a: If the payment is at or below the monthly interest charge, the balance never shrinks — the tool will warn you to raise it.
No. It assumes the fixed rate you enter for the whole payoff period.
